text:
```yaml
name: Release binaries

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

env:
  GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build binaries (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Crystal
        uses: crystal-lang/setup-crystal@v1.0.0
        with:
          crystal: latest

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          if [ "${{ runner.os }}" = "Linux" ]; then
            sudo apt-get update
            sudo apt-get install -y libssl-dev libsqlite3-dev
          elif [ "${{ runner.os }}" = "macOS" ]; then
            brew install openssl sqlite3
          fi

      - name: Build binary
        run: |
          mkdir -p bin
          if [ "${{ runner.os }}" = "Windows" ]; then
            crystal build src/noir.cr --release --progress -o bin/noir-${{ runner.os }}.exe
          else
            crystal build src/noir.cr --release --progress --static -o bin/noir-${{ runner.os }}
          fi

      - name: Upload release assets
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          files: bin/*
```
